name: Paessler PRTG
description: Paessler PRTG automation: devices, groups, probes, sensors, channels

a1a1.name: ListDevices
a1a1.description: Returns a list of devices.

a1a1.name: GetDevice
a1a1.description: Returns the metrics and settings of a device.

a1a1.name: UpdateDevice
a1a1.description: Edits a device.

a1a1.name: DeleteDevice
a1a1.description: Deletes a device with all child sensors and channels.

a1a1.name: PauseDevice
a1a1.description: Pauses a device.

a1a1.name: ResumeDevice
a1a1.description: Resumes a device.

a1a1.name: ListGroups
a1a1.description: Get a list of all groups that match a filter.

a1a1.name: GetGroup
a1a1.description: Returns the metrics and settings of a group.

a1a1.name: UpdateGroup
a1a1.description: Edits a group.

a1a1.name: DeleteGroup
a1a1.description: Deletes a group with all child groups and devices.

a1a1.name: ListProbes
a1a1.description: Get a list of all probes that match a filter.

a1a1.name: GetProbe
a1a1.description: Returns the metrics and settings of a probe.

a1a1.name: PauseProbe
a1a1.description: Pauses a probe.

a1a1.name: ResumeProbe
a1a1.description: Resumes a probe.

a1a1.name: DeleteProbe
a1a1.description: Deletes a probe with all child groups and devices.

a1a1.name: ListSensors
a1a1.description: Returns a list of all sensors that match a filter.

a1a1.name: GetSensor
a1a1.description: Returns metrics and settings of a sensor.

a1a1.name: UpdateSensor
a1a1.description: Edits a sensor.

a1a1.name: DeleteSensor
a1a1.description: Deletes a sensor with all child channels.

a1a1.name: PauseSensor
a1a1.description: Pauses a sensor.

a1a1.name: ResumeSensor
a1a1.description: Resumes a sensor.

a1a1.name: AcknowledgeSensor
a1a1.description: Acknowledges the alarm of a sensor.

a1a1.name: ListChannels
a1a1.description: Returns a list of channels.

a1a1.name: GetChannel
a1a1.description: Returns the metrics and settings of a channel.
